camera_structure.observation: Sky title leads into downward image reveal of runner and physical banner; runner shares sky backdrop. Do not treat this as two unrelated scenes. Type/banner remain visual anchors.

Frontal center person holds position while megaphones enter from sides and above. End briefly pushes/defocuses before cut. Crowding derives from independent prop entrances, not continual camera orbit.

Three genuinely top-down photographic workstation plates, each with people surrounding horizontal desktop. Small abrupt reframing/plate changes, stable editorial holds; casting and light materially change between plates.
Blank ivory reset, then mismatch assembled body and oversized burgundy 5. Person is left-heavy, number overlaps/right-side. Large amount of empty stage is intentional.

Logo/title begins near middle then reduces/migrates upward as map enters beneath it. Map pulls back as more pins/path appear; first pin moves toward upper portion and shrinks. This is primarily a progressive pullback/reveal, not constant horizontal path tracking.
Audience/photo cutouts build diagonally across lower stage under two-line header. Repetition expands and then punch reframes.
Plant and physical name lettering sit low center; upper header takes phrase additions. The image itself stays almost steady.
Physical hand/paper transfer with flowing burgundy loop shapes across middle and bottom. Papers overlap and curl; headings build above. Small push, then brief defocus/flash.
Frontal monitor body remains lower-middle; screen cards multiply within the screen mask. Copy grows above. Genuine monitor bezel and stand essential.
Frontal webpage moves vertically upward as if scrolled. Different screen sections replace earlier sections; it is not a diagonal-card shot yet.

Perspective card field has tilted rows and real shadow separation. Artwork generally travels up-left, equivalent to camera travel down-right; strong initial change from wide field to closer framing, then steady traverse. Direction approximate from visual card tracking.

Primarily IVORY portfolio grid of two horizontal rows of portrait cards, drifting left as cards/designs change. Dark frames are negative-color flashes and transient dark resets. Do not conclude dark stage is a sustained source scene from 1fps sheets.
Extremely sparse small closing copy centered in ivory. First line moves/adds, second line appears later; otherwise hold. Brief negative flash ~34.1333-34.2667 is not a new scene.

production_feedback: Fresh photo assets should follow structural layout and camera language rather than copying reference subjects or content.
Keep genuine overhead table shots distinct from frontal office imagery.
Build diagonal card field with perspective geometry, contact shadows, and continuous up-left artwork travel rather than simple face-on carousel.
Do not derive motion density from uniform animation: pressure props accelerate; map progressively reveals/pulls back; closing remains nearly still.

Negative-color flicker exists frequently in supplied reference. If target avoids flicker, document that as deliberate accessibility/readability adaptation rather than falsely reporting a faithful omission.
Previous brief approximation overestimated monitor start (~22.7 vs measured normal 22.5) and diagonal-grid onset (~26 vs measured 27.0), and interpreted dark cards as sustained dark scene.
